findings.headline: Drop the undefined check on line 11; useContext(TodosContext) now throws without a Provider.
findings.why: TodosContext is created without a default. Solid 1.x returned undefined from useContext outside a Provider; Solid 2.0.0 types the result as the context's type and throws ContextNotFoundError instead.
findings.guidance: Delete the check and return the useContext result directly; the hook only existed to narrow the type. If many callers use the hook, keeping it as a one-line alias is fine.

findings.headline: The undefined fallback on line 17 never runs; useContext(TodosContext) now throws without a Provider.
findings.why: TodosContext is created without a default. Solid 1.x returned undefined from useContext outside a Provider; Solid 2.0.0 types the result as the context's type and throws ContextNotFoundError instead.
findings.guidance: If code here must work outside a Provider, give the context an explicit empty value, createContext<T | null>(null), and check for null. undefined is never a context value in Solid 2, so createContext<T | undefined>(undefined) still throws. Otherwise remove the fallback.
